description: In monkeys reporting either the motion or the color of moving dots, multi-unit activity in the frontal eye field carried the unreported feature almost as well as the reported one (Mante et al. 2013, as reported by Odegaard, Knight and Lau).
limitations: Reported secondhand. The original study is not among the sources read. Trained animals switching between tasks may prepare both reports, which Odegaard and colleagues argue is unlikely.

sources.quote: PFC multi-unit activity was found to reflect an unreported feature of a stimulus, even when the animal had to report on a different, orthogonal stimulus feature
